WITH transaction_sentiment AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) as avg_short_interest,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
order_type_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) as ordertypedist_avg_short_interest
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  ts.transreg,
  ts.ordertypedist,
  ts.avg_short_interest,
  ts.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  CASE 
    WHEN ts.avg_short_interest IS NOT NULL AND ota.ordertypedist_avg_short_interest IS NOT NULL
    THEN ts.avg_short_interest / ota.ordertypedist_avg_short_interest
    ELSE NULL
  END as short_interest_ratio
FROM transaction_sentiment ts
LEFT JOIN order_type_avg ota ON ts.ordertypedist = ota.ordertypedist
ORDER BY CASE WHEN short_interest_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, short_interest_ratio DESC
